ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon GammaLoad/Pterodo VBS dropper beaconing to DDNS C2 (ddns.net/hopto.org/myftp.biz)
ucs.description: Hunts the signature post-install behavior of Gamaredon's GammaLoad/Pterodo VBS implant: a Windows script host (wscript/cscript/mshta) or PowerShell making outbound HTTP/S to one of the third-party Dynamic-DNS providers Gamaredon (Aqua Blizzard / Shuckworm / Primitive Bear) is famous for parking C2 on. The combination of script-interpreter parent + DDNS-provider destination is extremely actor-specific.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as dest_ips values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as dest_ports from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.process_name IN ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe") AND (All_Traffic.dest_host="*.ddns.net" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.hopto.org" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.myftp.biz" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.myftp.org" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.sytes.net" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.serveirc.com" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.linkpc.net" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.zapto.org" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.redirectme.net" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.bounceme.net" OR All_Traffic.dest_host="*.ignorelist.com") by host All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.dest_host | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | where count < 200 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Gamaredon / Aqua Blizzard / Shuckworm — GammaLoad VBS implant calling DDNS C2
let GamaredonDDNS = dynamic("ddns.net","hopto.org","myftp.biz","myftp.org","sytes.net","serveirc.com","linkpc.net","zapto.org","redirectme.net","bounceme.net","ignorelist.com","blogdns.com","servehttp.com");
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| extend RemoteHost = tolower(tostring(parse_url(RemoteUrl).Host))
| where isnotempty(RemoteHost)
| where RemoteHost has_any (GamaredonDDNS)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          AccountName  = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          ScriptHost   = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentImage  = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          Cmd          = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          RemoteHost, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Gamaredon — DDNS C2 callbacks. ImDnsActivity gives cross-vendor coverage; pivot to ImProcessCreate on SrcHostname to confirm script-host parent.
let GamaredonDDNS = dynamic(".ddns.net",".hopto.org",".myftp.biz",".myftp.org",".sytes.net",".serveirc.com",".linkpc.net",".zapto.org",".redirectme.net",".bounceme.net",".ignorelist.com");
let Resolvers = ImDnsActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | extend q = tolower(DnsQuery)
    | where q has_any (GamaredonDDNS)
    | project TimeGenerated, SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr, DnsQuery, DnsResponseName;
let ScriptHostExec = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ActingProcessName has_any ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
           or TargetProcessName has_any ("wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | project ProcTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActingProcessName, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername;
Resolvers
| join kind=inner ScriptHostExec on $left.SrcHostname == $right.DvcHostname
| where ProcTime between (TimeGenerated - 5m .. TimeGenerated + 5m)
| project TimeGenerated, SrcHostname, ActorUsername, ScriptHost = coalesce(TargetProcessName, ActingProcessName), Cmd = TargetProcessCommandLine, DnsQuery, DnsResponseName, SrcIpAddr
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Gamaredon PteroLNK USB worm — LNK fan-out on removable-drive roots
ucs.description: Hunts the propagation primitive of Gamaredon's PteroLNK / GammaSteel USB worm: a single host process (PowerShell, wscript, or cscript) writing multiple .lnk decoy shortcuts into the root of removable drives within a short window. CERT-UA, Symantec Shuckworm, and Unit 42 have all attributed this fan-out pattern uniquely to Gamaredon's air-gap bridging tradecraft against Ukrainian targets.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count(Filesystem.file_name) as LnkCount values(Filesystem.file_name) as LnkSamples values(Filesystem.file_path) as Paths min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.action="created" AND Filesystem.file_name="*.lnk" AND (Filesystem.file_path="D:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="E:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="F:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="G:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="H:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="I:\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="J:\\*") AND Filesystem.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe") by _time span=15m host Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where LnkCount >= 3 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Gamaredon PteroLNK USB worm — script host writing multiple .lnk decoys into removable-drive roots within 15 min.
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FileName endswith ".lnk"
| where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\?$"           // exact root of a non-system drive
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize LnkCount = count(),
            DistinctDrives = dcount(substring(FolderPath, 0, 2)),
            SampleNames = make_set(FileName, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen  = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine)
            by bin(Timestamp, 15m), DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName
| where LnkCount >= 3                                          // 3 = empirical fan-out floor — single LNK = noise
| project FirstSeen, LastSeen, DeviceName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          DropperProcess=InitiatingProcessFileName, LnkCount, DistinctDrives, SampleNames, SampleCmd
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Gamaredon PteroLNK USB worm — ASIM file-event view of script host writing .lnk decoys to removable drive roots.
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType == "FileCreated"
| where TargetFileName endswith ".lnk"
| where TargetFilePath matches regex @"(?i)^[D-Z]:\\?[^\\]+\.lnk$"
| where ActingProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| summarize LnkCount = count(),
            DistinctDrives = dcount(substring(TargetFilePath, 0, 2)),
            SampleNames = make_set(TargetFileName, 10),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen  = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
            by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName
| where LnkCount >= 3
| project TimeGenerated = LastSeen, FirstSeen, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, DropperProcess = ActingProcessName, LnkCount, DistinctDrives, SampleNames, SampleCmd
| order by TimeGenerated desc

status: experimental
description: Detects script interpreters writing .lnk shortcut files into the root of removable drives (D:-Z:), a propagation primitive used by Gamaredon's PteroLNK / GammaSteel USB worm against air-gap targets.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0047/

author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/02

  product: windows

      - '\cscript.exe'

    TargetFilename|endswith: '.lnk'
